messages:
sara_sales: Heads-up  LATAM reseller (BrisaTech, BR) asked for a one-off channel margin bump to close a regulated telecom POC. Tagging @miguel_partnerships @olivia_dealdesk

miguel_partnerships: what's the exact ask? how far off our BR rate card?

sara_sales: they want 30% reseller margin for a 90-day POC and then 24% for 12 months if they secure a $180k ARR commit. Standard Brazil channel margin is 18%. They also want BRL invoicing and a BRL 50k MDF.

olivia_dealdesk: big gap. We need a quick margin impact + RevOps calc and confirmation on billing currency risk. Also need to know if MDF will be paid upfront or as a rebate.

sam_finance: finance flags: BRL invoicing introduces FX risk and withholding/tax implications. MDF that large needs clawback language. Require RevOps model and AR contact.

noah_ps: POC PS estimate ~55 hours. If MDF doesn't cover PS, we need a PS voucher. Also require SOC2 summary + DPA before any customer data exchange.

miguel_partnerships: tentatively ok for a time-limited concession if: 1) partner signs a binding addendum with $180k commit & MDF clawback, 2) MDF coded to co-marketing with clawback, 3) legal approves BRL invoice terms and DPA, 4) finance accepts FX handling. I'll escalate to regional GM.

olivia_dealdesk: Opening ticket DD-10333 to track approvals and attach docs. Please upload CRM opp id, margin calc, SOW, and proposed clawback language. https://redwood.company/dealdesk/DD-10333 :eyes:

deal-bot: Ticket DD-10333 created  status: Open  awaiting finance + legal review.

sara_sales: CRM opp: RDW-BR-2210. Quick inline calc for reviewers:

```
POC list price (example): $80,000
Requested reseller margin (30%): partner takes $24,000
MDF requested (BRL50k ~ $10k) credited to partner
Net to Redwood on POC: $80,000 - 24,000 - 10,000 = $46,000
Baseline (18% margin): partner $14,400 -> net $65,600 -> approx delta on POC: -$19,600
```

sam_finance: need USD equivalents, VAT/ISS treatment, and whether MDF is prepaid cash or credit. Also confirm monthly vs upfront invoicing.

miguel_partnerships: next steps: 1) get partner to sign draft addendum with commit + clawback 2) legal to review BRL invoicing/DPA 3) RevOps to model ARR scenarios and FX exposure 4) deal-desk DD-10333 to collect docs. If all green, approve temporary 30% margin for 90 days with structured clawback.

sara_sales: I'll get partner to sign addendum and upload SOW + PS owners. Thanks all :thumbsup:
